data.name: Tales of Immortal Cultivation
data.detailed_description:
We don't like to play with those colorful lobsters that can change their shells.

We aspire to present players with a comprehensive, dynamic, sandbox-style, and richly detailed world of cultivation.

We hope to play the following content: sect rivalry, family cultivation, terminal crisis, and era struggle

Thus, "Tales of Immortal Cultivation" was born.

Customizable infinite sandbox world

We have designed a method that enables the dynamic generation of sandbox worlds. Players can freely design and choose the world they want to play in.

More reasonable simulation of cultivation events

The stories in the world of cultivation are complex and ever-changing. We have designed an era-situation mechanism to simulate events in the cultivation realm. Each situation corresponds to multiple stages, and all events that occur in the cultivation world, whether they are NPCs or players, will increase the progress of different situations, thereby advancing the situation to different stages. Situations are nested with each other, and the end of one situation will trigger the occurrence of another.

Reincarnation system

You don't need to accomplish all your goals at once. The death of a character doesn't mean the end of the game. The game world continues to operate, and the player is merely a struggling member of the world of cultivation. Each reincarnation you undergo will make your next life stronger!

Rich and free cultivation system gameplay

Alchemy and artifact crafting, auction and trade, farming in the cave abode, discussing and cultivating both Dao and arts, puppet and beast taming. We have incorporated a plethora of gameplay elements into the game, encompassing everything one might encounter in the realm of cultivation.

data.short_description: Tales of Immortal Cultivation: A turn-based RPG in a vast, random cultivation sandbox. Forge your path as a lone cultivator, join sects, or build a clan. Every choice shapes your fate in this perilous world. Survive the realm's dangers, break the cycle of reincarnation, and ascend to immortality!
